entries.gloss: an impediment (or preventive measure) to the ruling or state is present: prevention, which the qaida says is easier than removal

anchor.excerpt_ar: المنع أسهل من الرفع

entries.gloss: the impediment is present at the outset, before the ruling or state is established, rather than supervening on it

anchor.excerpt_ar: يمنعه ابتداء ولا يفسخه في الدوام

entries.gloss: the bar on intercourse is due to the weakness or deficiency of the ownership, or fear that it is not established

anchor.excerpt_ar: لضعف الملك وقصوره أو خشية عدم ثبوته

entries.gloss: the bar on intercourse is an act of worship that prevents intercourse

anchor.excerpt_ar: العبادات المانعة من الوطء

entries.gloss: the worship bars the genus of indulgence and enjoyment of women (strong ihram, itikaf), not intercourse alone

anchor.excerpt_ar: ضرب يمتنع فيه جنس الترفه والاستمتاع بالنساء

entries.gloss: what deliberate killing makes due is one of two things, qawad or diya, not qawad specifically

anchor.excerpt_ar: أحد أمرين إما القود وإما الدية

entries.gloss: the slave killed was property to which another party's right was already attached (e.g. the pledgee's right in a pledged slave)

anchor.excerpt_ar: تعلق حقه برقبة العبد المرهون

entries.gloss: the one killed was a slave owned by the claimant who makes the sulh (a slave of his trade wealth)

anchor.excerpt_ar: عبدا من مال التجارة عمدا فصالح المالك عنه بمال

entries.gloss: the thing burdened with a right of God or of a person is guaranteed (madmuna)

anchor.excerpt_ar: فإن كانت مضمونة

entries.gloss: the thing was destroyed by an act (itlaf), as against perishing (talaf), which does not make an unguaranteed thing liable

anchor.excerpt_ar: لم يجب ضمانها بالتلف ووجب بالإتلاف

entries.gloss: there is an existing beneficiary entitled to the right in the thing

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن كان مستحق موجود وإلا فلا

entries.gloss: the holder of the unfixed right takes the whole when he is alone (as the agnates beside the sharers)

anchor.excerpt_ar: من لم يقدر حقه يستحق الجميع عند الانفراد

entries.gloss: the unfixed right is estimated by ijtihad, but the estimate goes back to a base that governs it

anchor.excerpt_ar: يرجع إلى أصل يضبط به

entries.gloss: the fixed and the estimated right fall on one and the same locus

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن كان محلهما واحدا

entries.gloss: the destroyer is the one bound to keep the thing (burdened with a right of God) and render it until a known term

anchor.excerpt_ar: من يجب عليه حفظها واستيفاؤها إلى مدة معلومة

entries.gloss: what was lost returned by the original creation (regrowth, a limb that takes hold), not by human making

anchor.excerpt_ar: عاد بأصل الخلقة

entries.gloss: what was rebuilt was rebuilt with its own former materials

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن أعاده بآلته العتيقة

entries.gloss: the original is given up for a price, rather than exchanged for a like substitute

anchor.excerpt_ar: بخلاف ما لو باعه بثمن

entries.gloss: the right of the deceased is one that falls due by his death (diya, qisas for his life)

anchor.excerpt_ar: من حقوقه يجب بموته

entries.gloss: the right was due to him in his life and he had claimed it, or it was in his hand

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن كان قد طالب به أو هو في يده

entries.gloss: the right is a property right attached to the property the heirs inherit (rahn, kafala, daman, a debt's term, return for defect)

anchor.excerpt_ar: حقوق أملاك ثابتة متعلقة بالأملاك الموروثة

entries.gloss: the right owed by the deceased is binding (lazim)

anchor.excerpt_ar: فإذا كانت لازمة قام الوارث مقامه

entries.gloss: the obligation is a permissible contract that tends to bindingness (rahn or hiba before delivery)

anchor.excerpt_ar: لأنه عقد يئول إلى اللزوم

entries.gloss: the finally divorced (bain) woman is still in her idda

anchor.excerpt_ar: المعتدة البائن في حكم الزوجات

entries.gloss: the remaining ties of the marriage have been cut (by her death)

anchor.excerpt_ar: لانقطاع علق الزوجية عنه بموتها

entries.gloss: the woman is a revocably divorced wife (rajiyya) in her idda

anchor.excerpt_ar: المطلقة الرجعية

entries.gloss: the ruling is one of the points (suwar) the qaida lists on which the rajiyya differs from wives

anchor.excerpt_ar: تفارق المطلقة الرجعية الزوجات في صور

entries.gloss: the party whose measure is in question is a woman

anchor.excerpt_ar: أحكام النساء

entries.gloss: the ruling is one of the places (mawadi) the qaida lists where women's rulings are half of men's

anchor.excerpt_ar: على النصف من أحكام الرجال في مواضع

entries.gloss: the right is established for a determinate holder (a known heir, owner or creditor)

anchor.excerpt_ar: الحق الثابت لمعين

entries.gloss: the transfer of ownership (gift, waiver, added portion) was made because of a cause, and causes count in such contracts

anchor.excerpt_ar: تعتبر الأسباب في عقود التمليكات

entries.gloss: another cause is shown for the gift: a prior custom of gifting between them, independent of the loan or office

anchor.excerpt_ar: ممن لم يجر له منه عادة

entries.gloss: the circumstance (hal) agrees with the claim, which is then accepted

anchor.excerpt_ar: قبول دعوى ما يوافقها

entries.gloss: the circumstance contradicts the claim, which is then rejected

anchor.excerpt_ar: ورد ما يخالفها

entries.gloss: she falls under the dabit of prohibition by lineage: one's ascendants, descendants, the descendants of the nearest ascendant, and the immediate daughters of remoter ascendants

anchor.excerpt_ar: يحرم على الإنسان أصوله وفروعه، وفروع أصله الأدنى وإن سفلن، وفروع أصوله البعيدة دون بناتهن

entries.gloss: she is in one of the four classes prohibited by affinity

anchor.excerpt_ar: حلائل الآباء والأبناء وأمهات النساء وبنات النساء المدخول بهن

entries.gloss: she and a wife already held are two women with a mahram kinship between them by lineage (were one male he could not marry the other), so combining them is prohibited

anchor.excerpt_ar: فكل امرأتين بينهما رحم محرم يحرم الجمع بينهما بحيث لو كانت إحداهما ذكرا لم يجز له التزوج بالأخرى لأجل النسب دون الصهر

entries.gloss: she stands to him by fosterage where by lineage she would fall under one of the three preceding kinds

anchor.excerpt_ar: فيحرم به ما يحرم من النسب في الأنواع الثلاثة المتقدمة

entries.gloss: the ruling is of the first kind: the grandchild is included under "child" absolutely, whether the child exists or not

anchor.excerpt_ar: يدخل في مسماه مطلقا مع وجود الولد وعدمه

entries.gloss: the ruling is of the second kind: the grandchild is included when the child is absent, not when present

anchor.excerpt_ar: ما يدخل فيه عند عدم الولد لا مع وجوده

entries.gloss: the intermediate child (the grandchild's parent) exists

anchor.excerpt_ar: مع وجود الولد

entries.gloss: the one who spoiled the marriage before consummation fixed on the husband the half-mahr (for a bud he had not consummated)

anchor.excerpt_ar: المفسد قرر هذا النصف على الزوج

entries.gloss: the husband, his marriage still standing, chooses the mahr in place of his wife (the returning missing husband)

anchor.excerpt_ar: فإنه يخير بين زوجته وبين المهر

entries.gloss: the one the exit of the bud would be charged to is the wife herself, whom the majority exclude from the dispute

anchor.excerpt_ar: وخصوا هذا الخلاف بمن عدا الزوجة

entries.gloss: he had intercourse with her, which establishes the whole mahr in every case

anchor.excerpt_ar: الوطء فيتقرر به المهر على كل حال

entries.gloss: he was alone with her in seclusion (khalwa), the second establishing cause

anchor.excerpt_ar: والثاني: الخلوة

entries.gloss: the one alone with her is one whose like can have intercourse

anchor.excerpt_ar: ممن يمكن الوطء بمثله

entries.gloss: one of the spouses died before consummation, the third establishing cause

anchor.excerpt_ar: الموت قبل الدخول

entries.gloss: the separation before consummation comes from the husband's side alone

anchor.excerpt_ar: من جهة الزوج وحده

entries.gloss: the separation before consummation comes from a stranger's side alone

anchor.excerpt_ar: من جهة أجنبي وحده

entries.gloss: the separation before consummation comes from the wife's side alone

anchor.excerpt_ar: من جهة الزوجة وحدها

entries.gloss: the separation is an annulment the husband holds for a harm to him (her defect, a lapsed condition), excepted from the husband's kind

anchor.excerpt_ar: الفسوخ التي يملكها الزوج لضرر يلحقه

entries.gloss: the woman's state changes during the idda (slave to free) or a cause of another idda from the husband (his death) supervenes

anchor.excerpt_ar: تغير حال المرأة التي في العدة بانتقالها من رق إلى حرية أو طرأ عليها سبب موجب لعدة أخرى من الزوج

entries.gloss: the husband is able to remedy (restore) the marriage within the idda

anchor.excerpt_ar: إن كان زوجها متمكنا من تلافي نكاحها في العدة

entries.gloss: the case is the excepted one: her final separation (ibana) by a husband in his illness

anchor.excerpt_ar: إلا ما يستثنى من ذلك من الإبانة في المريض

entries.gloss: the first-stated of the two conflicting usul is reinforced by what makes it preponderate

anchor.excerpt_ar: عمل بالأرجح منهما لاعتضاده بما يرجحه

entries.gloss: the second-stated of the two conflicting usul is reinforced by what makes it preponderate

anchor.excerpt_ar: عمل بالأرجح منهما لاعتضاده بما يرجحه
